_doc: Style-guide derived terminology rules for term_lint.py (pgnls ref/style-guide.md R3.1/R3.2/R4.1). A rule fires only when 'en' matches the English source AND 'zh_forbidden' matches the Chinese translation. Matching is per segment (whole comment / message), so a forbidden rendering may legitimately co-occur with a correct one inside one segment. Therefore 'severity' is mandatory: 'error' (fails the run) is reserved for renderings that are wrong in every PostgreSQL context; anything that is merely usually wrong is 'warning' (reported, exit 0). preserve_terms must appear verbatim in the translation whenever they appear in the source (error). Keep this list conservative; false positives go to an allowlist with a reason, not here.

rules.note: cluster → 数据库集簇/集簇 (pgdoc rule 121); 集群 only for distributed multi-node systems -> allowlist with reason
cluster must not be rendered as a bare 簇; CLUSTER as an action is 聚簇 (warning: 簇 may describe other groupings in the same comment)
standby → 备库 (pgdoc rule 522); 后备 only for spare equipment (warning: both may co-occur)
connection → 连接, never the old 联接
out of memory → 内存不足
vacuum → 清理 (pgdoc rule 597); 真空 is never right in PostgreSQL
requires → 需要; 要求 may legitimately render requirement/demand in the same segment
quotes must stay ASCII double quotes (style guide R4.1)
deprecated → 已弃用; 过时/废弃 may render obsolete/stale nearby

rules.zh_forbidden: 外部数据封装器|外部数据包装程序
rules.note: foreign data wrapper → 外部数据包装器
